title: AI Workflow Plan
description: Schema for a structured workflow plan produced by the planner.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow type

id.description: Unique step identifier within this plan

capability.description: Capability name that maps to an agent

inputs.description: Step inputs; $ref values reference state keys

outputs.description: List of state keys this step will produce

idempotent.description: If true, completed step with all outputs present will be skipped on resume

retryable.description: If true, executor will retry once on StepFailure

requires_approval.description: If true, executor will pause for user approval before executing
